claims.statement: RESTHeart CLI follows a layered architecture with four distinct layers: CLI Layer (lib/cli.js) for user interaction, Manager Layer (lib/restheart.js) for orchestration, Component Layer for domain-specific logic, and Infrastructure Layer for cross-cutting concerns.

The CLI Layer (lib/cli.js) uses yargs for command parsing with strict mode and populate-- configuration to capture RESTHeart options after -- separator, routes commands to RESTHeartManager methods via runCommand function, handles global options (debug, verbose, quiet, timestamps, build-system), intercepts SIGINT signals to kill RESTHeart before exiting, and implements global error handling for uncaught exceptions and unhandled rejections.

RESTHeartManager (lib/restheart.js) acts as the orchestration layer implementing the facade pattern, provides simplified public API methods (install, build, deploy, run, watchFiles, kill, status, isRunning, checkAndKill), and wires components via dependency injection where Builder, ProcessManager, Installer, and Watcher receive ConfigManager in their constructors.

Components use dependency injection where ConfigManager is injected into Builder, ProcessManager, Installer, and Watcher constructors, with Installer also receiving Builder instance, and Watcher receiving both ProcessManager and Builder.

ConfigManager (lib/config.js) manages runtime configuration with validation for httpPort (1-65535), debugMode (boolean), buildSystem (auto/maven/gradle), ensures cache directories exist, and provides getter/setter methods for configuration values.

Builder (lib/builder.js) delegates build system specifics to build-systems module via resolveBuildSystem function, cleans target directory before building, returns to original directory after build (even on failure), and uses silent shell execution with deduplicated error output.

Build system auto-detection (lib/build-systems/index.js) checks for explicit --build-system option first, then looks for pom.xml or mvnw for Maven, then gradlew/build.gradle/build.gradle.kts/settings.gradle/settings.gradle.kts for Gradle, defaulting to Maven when neither detected.

Installer (lib/installer.js) supports two installation strategies: remote download from GitHub releases for versions, and local installation from directories detected by path separators (/ or \). It checks for Java installation via commandExists, verifies existing installations to avoid redundant downloads, and supports force reinstallation with --force flag.

ProcessManager (lib/process-manager.js) manages RESTHeart process lifecycle with run() starting background process via nohup, kill() using lsof for port-specific detection with ps-list fallback and SIGTERM/SIGKILL escalation after 15s timeout, isRunning() checking both httpPort and httpPort+1000 ports, and captures originalRHO environment variable at startup to prevent duplication on restart.

Watcher (lib/watcher.js) uses chokidar for cross-platform file watching with debouncing (default 1000ms), watches Java source files, build configuration files (pom.xml, build.gradle, etc.), and RESTHeart config files parsed from -o option, validates watch paths exist before starting, and coordinates rebuild-deploy-restart sequence on file changes.

ErrorHandler (lib/error-handler.js) provides centralized error handling with static methods for different error categories (handleError, commandNotFound, configError, processError, fileSystemError, networkError), controls process exit behavior via exitProcess option, manages stack trace visibility via showStack option, and logs stack traces at DEBUG level.

Utils (lib/utils.js) provides shared utility functions: commandExists checks system commands via shell.which and throws ErrorHandler.commandNotFound if missing, checkPort verifies port availability across IPv4/IPv6 hosts with 2-second timeout, createSpinner creates ora spinner instances, and ensureDir creates directories recursively via shell.mkdir with ErrorHandler.fileSystemError on failure.

The runCommand function in cli.js routes commands via switch statement: install calls rh.install(), build calls rh.build('clean package') then rh.deploy(), run checks onlyPrintConfig then optionally checkAndKill and build/deploy before rh.run(), kill calls checkAndKill(), watch calls checkAndKill then optionally build/deploy then rh.run() and rh.watchFiles(), status calls rh.status().

Gradle build system (lib/build-systems/gradle.js) maps Maven-style build parameters via mapBuildParams: 'package' maps to 'build', 'clean package' maps to 'clean build', other values pass through unchanged, and uses -x test flag for skipping tests.
ProcessManager parses RESTHeart YAML configuration file (specified via -o flag) to extract host and port settings using js-yaml, falling back to defaults if parsing fails.

Watcher's processFileUpdate method distinguishes between Java source changes, build configuration changes, and RESTHeart config changes, applying different rebuild strategies: full rebuild for Java/build config, restart-only for config changes, and full rebuild as fallback for unknown file types.

Tests use vitest with mocking of shell commands (shell.exec), file system operations (fs.existsSync, fs.readFileSync), process management (process.kill, ps-list), and component methods to test individual components in isolation.

Logger (lib/logger.js) implements a numeric level system with DEBUG (0), INFO (1), SUCCESS (2), WARNING (3), ERROR (4) levels, provides color-coded output methods (debug=gray, info=cyan, success=green, warning=yellow, error=red), includes status() for bold white lifecycle events and log() that bypasses level filtering, and supports verbosity control via setLevel() method.
CLI intercepts SIGINT signals via process.on('SIGINT') to ensure clean shutdown: checks if RESTHeart is running via rh.isRunning(), kills the process via rh.kill() if running, then exits with code 0.

CLI uses yargs parserConfiguration with 'populate--': true to capture arguments after -- separator into argv['--'] array, which runCommand joins into a space-separated string and passes to RESTHeartManager methods as restheartOptions.
